import json, urllib.request

def call(endpoint, payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request('https://slack.com/api/'+endpoint,
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req))

# paginate conversations
cursor = None
found = []
all_channels = []
while True:
    p = {'token':'<TOKEN>','types':'public_channel,private_channel','exclude_archived':True,'limit':1000}
    if cursor: p['cursor']=cursor
    d = call('conversations.list', p)
    if not d.get('ok'):
        print('ERROR:', d); break
    for c in d.get('channels',[]):
        all_channels.append((c['id'], c.get('name'), c.get('topic',{}).get('value','')))
    nc = d.get('response_metadata',{}).get('next_cursor')
    if not nc: break
    cursor = nc
    if len(cursor or '') and len(all_channels) > 5000: break

print('total channels:', len(all_channels))
for cid,name,topic in all_channels:
    print(cid,'|',name,'| topic:',topic)
EOF
